security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Every app, for any Linux distro
bundle.longDescription: Whistle is one app store for every Linux distro, with Windows apps included. It installs each app the best way your computer allows: your distro's own package, a Flatpak, or a Windows app through Wine.
